purpose: Freeze a deterministic R2 representative retrieval-title selection without treating the selected title as the canonical title of the literary work.

semantics.resolved_w_rule: For each project_work_id in project_works_v4, select the Open Library title alias whose alias_project_source_entity_id equals origin_unit_anchor_entity_id.
semantics.unresolved_rule: For each MANUAL_REVIEW_REQUIRED unresolved aggregation unit, select the Open Library title alias whose source entity equals unit_anchor_entity_id. This supports parallel retrieval but does not create or imply a project_work_id.
semantics.why_anchor_based: R2 is a stable identity-structural baseline, not an optimized best-title heuristic. Retrieval improvement from additional aliases is evaluated separately through R3.
